paper_anchor: Section 4.1, Lemma 13 and Theorem 14; Appendix G, Lemma 44 and Theorem 46
quantifier: there exist agents, weights, and a compatible split
precondition: the parent P1 has a strictly positive welfare gap in the original log pool
compatibility: the weighted child log pool reconstructs P1 and global child weights sum to beta1
conclusion: the global pool is unchanged but at least one child has a strictly negative welfare gap
